crossRefs.note: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
“Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…
Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and…
Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth?’
My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were…
I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: Yahweh has called me from the womb; from the inside of my…
Now Yahweh, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to…
“Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to…
Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’
He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,
But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace
But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

translations.web: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
translations.bsb: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
translations.kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually
translations.asv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb; Thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.
